facts.title: Loki balance
facts.text: Explosive Acceleration cooldown 25s → 37.5s; full-bar Velocity Shot distance/speed −10%; passive −15%.

facts.title: August balance
facts.text: Explosive Acceleration CD 25s → 37.5s; full-bar Velocity Shot distance/speed −10%; passive −15%. Repeated in September 19 notes.

facts.title: June balance
facts.text: Passive speed −3%; Velocity Shot speed and range −10%; Explosive Acceleration hitbox −15%.

facts.title: Velocity overhaul
facts.text: Velocity cap 110% of Chigiri's Speedster after 11s at normal running pace; dribble reduces Velocity by 50 and sliding resets it. Explosive Acceleration adds 45 Velocity, costs 20 stamina, CD 40s at this date. Velocity Dash/Shot uses all Velocity, CD 20s. Swift Intercept grants free Explosive Acceleration on a successful catch.

facts.title: Ball trajectory metavision
facts.text: White line showing the estimated ball path introduced for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi.

facts.title: Aerial trap removed
facts.text: Godspeed Dash air variant removed; Gear Shift stamina consumption reduced.

facts.title: Heart and Brain of France
facts.text: Base version: Charles passes to Loki, who dashes to the ball and shoots. Awakening version was announced as a custom cutscene.

history.title: September quality of life
history.text: Watchtower added to Niko. Barou received aim and dribble adjustments; Loki and Lavinho were balanced. One goal counted as 1 MVP point and one save as 0.75. Per-style awakening outfits and party improvements arrived; summer map removed.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Awakening and performance fixes
history.text: Awakening bars draining during cutscenes fixed across many styles; major crash and lag fixes announced for new servers.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Great rebalancing
history.text: Ball Trajectory Metavision for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi. Loki base/passive overhaul; extensive style cooldown and range changes, removals and vaulting.

history.title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
history.text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.

history.title: Charles release
history.text: Charles released at World Class with Contrarian flow and Charles–Loki chemistry.

history.title: Loki and Godspeed
history.text: New Master style and flow rarities, Loki, Godspeed and exclusive velocity passive introduced.
